cases.input: Dataset snapshot and deployment context both change.
cases.expect: A new WM-AI-003 occurrence, new WM-AI-008 assessment and new explicit decision are required; old approval remains historical.

cases.input: A high benchmark score is used as universal safety proof and deployment permission.
cases.expect: Rejected; measurement is neither safety judgement nor authorization.

cases.input: A result omits uncertainty and limitations.
cases.expect: Rejected; the result cannot be accepted.

cases.input: An incident report replaces the observation record with embedded mutable evidence.
cases.expect: Rejected; the report must cite externally mastered immutable evidence.

cases.input: Plan is frozen before the run and result follows completion.
cases.expect: Accepted as one occurrence with three distinct roles.

pins.labelScope: fixture-local synthetic labels; not registry, model, catalogue or runtime identifiers

cases.input: After the dataset snapshot and context change, the prior evaluation, assessment and issued instrument are inspected for their original scope.
cases.expect: Accepted; prior records remain immutable and remain in force for internal-assist, and are non-transferable to external-customer-action.

cases.input: The arrival of a new deployment context is used to set the prior authorization for the unchanged context to invalid.
cases.expect: Rejected; change removes transferability to the new scope and never revokes the unchanged scope.

cases.input: The issued instrument is applied to the new context with no scope proof and no successor instrument.
cases.expect: Rejected; a new rationale, authorized act and issued instrument are required.

cases.input: The same sealed plan, run and pins are rescored with a later scorer version.
cases.expect: Accepted as an additive successor result citing the superseded result, with original value, scorer version, actor, time and reason preserved.

cases.input: A rescore replaces the stored original score in place.
cases.expect: Rejected; corrections are additive and the original is never overwritten.

cases.input: A pass threshold is lowered after the result is observed, with no authorized change record.
cases.expect: Rejected; thresholds precede results and a later change requires an authorized dated record disclosing prior result visibility.

cases.input: A harness failure is retried with byte-identical pins against the sealed plan.
cases.expect: Accepted as a second run sequence inside the same occurrence with the plan unchanged.

cases.input: A retry changes the inference configuration inside the existing occurrence.
cases.expect: Rejected; a pin delta requires a new occurrence with a newly sealed plan.

cases.input: A split label is offered as proof of non-contamination.
cases.expect: Rejected; non-overlap requires declared contamination evidence.

cases.input: A harm category with no metric is reported as carrying no residual risk.
cases.expect: Rejected; absence of a metric is not absence of risk and must be recorded as an unmeasured limitation.

cases.input: An assessment cites a result beyond its declared staleness interval without marking it stale.
cases.expect: Rejected; stale evidence is marked stale and is not silently carried.

cases.input: A result submits one timestamp for observation, ingestion and effect.
cases.expect: Rejected; event, observation, ingestion, approval, publication and effective instants are recorded distinctly.

cases.input: Hidden-test item content is embedded in a published profile artifact.
cases.expect: Rejected; protected benchmark items stay outside published artifacts and are cited by digest reference only.

cases.input: A dataset snapshot is bound to an evaluation with no declared licence or redistribution terms.
cases.expect: Rejected; rights are declared before use.

cases.input: A disaggregated result is reported for a subgroup below the declared minimum size.
cases.expect: Rejected; report suppression or aggregation is required and the limitation is recorded.

cases.input: A deployment-context label is treated as a resolvable master or catalogue identifier.
cases.expect: Rejected; no deployment or endpoint master is frozen and the label is a declared descriptor.

cases.input: A WM-AI-010 report reference is used as the master identity of the incident occurrence.
cases.expect: Rejected; WM-AI-010 masters the reporting case only and the occurrence has no frozen master.

cases.input: An evaluation gate approval or waiver is presented as deployment authorization.
cases.expect: Rejected; authorization requires WM-KNW-010 rationale, WM-ACT-024 act and WM-REC-010 instrument.

cases.input: Two WM-AI-008 revisions are marked authoritative at the same instant.
cases.expect: Rejected; exactly one revision is authoritative at any instant and superseded revisions remain resolvable.

cases.input: The profile is proposed for publication with null base versions and digests.
cases.expect: Rejected; unversioned base pins block profile publication and canonicalPublishable and installable remain false.

labelScope: fixture-local synthetic labels; not registry, model, catalogue or runtime identifiers
